title: SBA Loan Record
description: Schema for Small Business Administration loan data including PPP, 7(a), 504, disaster, SBIR, and STTR programs

loan_id.description: Unique identifier for the loan record

borrower_name.description: Legal name of the borrowing business or individual

borrower_state.description: Two-letter state abbreviation of the borrower

borrower_zip.description: Five-digit ZIP code of the borrower

naics_code.description: NAICS industry code for the borrower's primary business activity

naics_description.description: Human-readable description of the NAICS industry code

jobs_retained.description: Number of jobs retained as reported by the borrower

sba_office.description: SBA district office that processed the loan

forgiveness_amount.description: Amount forgiven under PPP forgiveness program (PPP only)

interest_rate.description: Annual interest rate as a decimal (e.g., 0.035 for 3.5%)

rural_urban.description: Rural or urban classification of the borrower location

business_type.description: Legal entity type of the borrowing business

load_time.description: Timestamp when the record was loaded into the data platform

_ingested_at.description: Timestamp when the record was ingested by the pipeline

_source.description: Source system or API endpoint that provided the record

_batch_id.description: Batch identifier for the ingestion run that produced this record
